title: Labeled form with inline validation messages

requiredStructure.name: full-name label+input pair, wired by aria-describedby
requiredStructure.pattern: <label for="full-name">Full name</label>\s*<input type="text" id="full-name" name="fullName" aria-describedby="full-name-error">

requiredStructure.name: full-name-error message, fixed copy
requiredStructure.pattern: Please enter your full name\.

requiredStructure.name: email label+input pair, wired by aria-describedby
requiredStructure.pattern: <label for="email">Email address</label>\s*<input type="email" id="email" name="email" aria-describedby="email-error">

requiredStructure.name: email-error message, fixed copy
requiredStructure.pattern: Please enter a valid email address\.

requiredStructure.name: password label+input pair, wired by aria-describedby
password-error message, fixed copy
requiredStructure.pattern: Password must be at least 8 characters\.
